# Change Log

Canonical WEPP build/version history for `wepp-forest`.

Required maintenance rule:
- update this file whenever a new build or rebuild is made (including new
  release-tagged binaries and version-affecting commits).
- add new entries at the top (descending chronology).

Reconstructed from `git log` using release/version-related commits (latest
first), through **07/19/2022**.

Historical 261010 disposition: Topanga/Rattlesnake validation is complete
(714 fresh hillslopes, four full-record watersheds). The January 18 target
peak changes from 707.63910 to 12.50683 m3/s. Roger approved promotion as
wepp_261010 after mutation, disturbed-ranking and Cedar verification. Ordinary
burned-event peak/sediment consequences remain disclosed; see the release notes.
